hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/radiometric-index, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.

unboundRoles added: the role index of radiometric-index (minOccurs 1) is left unbound, the live service not exposing OTB RadiometricIndices' list parameter (the testbed exception of docs/ATTACHMENTS.md). The binding was already incomplete; the entry now declares it.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/raster/radiometric-index to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/raster/radiometric-index, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/raster/radiometric-index/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

processDescription: in processDescription.inherited.json, each input and output that has a data type now names its representations (representation), the df:Representation items of bblocks-data-formats that realize that data type in a format the deployment declares (decision of 2026-11-18). Classified substantive: the form in which a part of the entry is stated changes.

definition: This application computes radiometric indices using the relevant channels of the input image. The output is a multi band image into which each channel is one of the selected indices.

unboundRoles.reason: no input of the live service selects the index: OTB RadiometricIndices' `list` parameter is not exposed

openeoEquivalence.rationale: OTB.RadiometricIndices computes a *selectable set* of named indices (NDVI, NDWI, and many others via `channels` / `list`) from user-mapped spectral channels (`channels.red`, `channels.nir`, ...), only one of which (NDVI) has a dedicated openEO process (`ndvi`, which also expects band-role mapping via `nir`/`red` parameters). closeMatch, not exactMatch: openEO has no equivalent for the other indices this application can compute.
